coordinate_policy: reuse iteration23 fixed latitude, longitude, and tau for each DS1 group; do not run a geographic search
mask_policy: TRAIN rows alone determine support, folds, rate profiles, per-fold CFO, scores, gates, and the decision; HELD is neither read nor scored
fold_policy: within each source, leave one complete TRAIN track out; fit the rate on all remaining TRAIN tracks, then fit only one CFO on the omitted track TRAIN rows and score those rows

rate_profile.method: iteration23 deterministic source-specific phase grid plus interleaved half-step scan, bounded refinement of every sampled local minimum, explicit endpoints and zero, and deterministic tie breaks
rate_profile.regularization: 0.5*(rate/RATE_SIGMA)^2 on each fold fit; omitted-track score contains observation loss only
rate_profile.prospective_rate_for_eligible_source: iteration23 full-TRAIN +/-1 s/hour diagnostic winner, subject to the cross-fit gates

gates.fold_convergence: every local refinement in every fold reports convergence
gates.exact_replay: for every fold winner, direct causal SGP4 and the iteration23 quartic surrogate differ by at most 0.2 Hz on the remaining TRAIN fit rows
gates.interior: every fold winner is farther from +/-1 s/hour than the iteration23 optimizer-aware boundary tolerance
gates.winning_basin_and_sign: all folds for a source select the same strict sign basin (negative or positive); a zero winner or mixed signs fails
gates.predictive_improvement: the sum of omitted-track pseudo-Huber observation losses across all folds is strictly below the corresponding zero-rate sum, with each omitted track counted once

decision_policy: go for a subsequent separately sealed prospective fixed-coordinate rate-model evaluation only if every eligible source passes every gate; ineligible sources remain exactly zero; this audit never authorizes or launches a geographic basin
